header: How we run the platform, stated plainly
subheadline: These are facts, not marketing claims. If one changes, the release notes say so first, and the status page keeps the full history.

items.title: Hosting
items.description_text: Frankfurt and Vienna, replicated between both. No data is processed outside the EU.

items.title: Uptime
items.description_text: 99.95%, measured monthly on the dispatch board and the mobile sync endpoint.

items.title: Release schedule
items.description_text: One feature release a month. Security patches within 72 hours of disclosure.

items.title: Data export
items.description_text: Full CSV and JSON export of jobs, assets and customers on every plan.

items.title: Notice period
items.description_text: Monthly plans end with 30 days' notice. Nothing is deleted for 90 days after that.
